sources.title: neonforestmist/smolgpt-fables · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SmolGPT-Fables is an experimental 6,032,640-parameter English Markdown story-format model trained from scratch. It writes structured short stories, continues story canvases, produces observable editorial passes, and can emit one bounded image.generate intent for a local host to validate and execute.
